source: Assets/ (Unity 2013-14 remake by Pedro Rodriguez; UnityScript)
unityVersionEvidence: No ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt. Texture metas use TextureImporter serializedVersion 2 with textureType 8 (Sprite) + spritePixelsToUnits, clips are AnimationClip serializedVersion 4 with m_PPtrCurves, controllers are AnimatorController serializedVersion 2 with State/Transition docs (!u!1102/!u!1101), and Physics2DSettings exists: Unity 4.3-4.6 era.

enumLegend.unityUnits: spritePixelsToUnits 100 => 100 px = 1 world unit; every scene camera has orthographic size 5 => 10 units = 1000 px of source art visible vertically.

payloadEstimate.method: Keep every texture referenced by a prefab/scene/asset plus every clip key; the decimated variant keeps only even-indexed keys of uniform 24 fps clips with >= 8 keys (12 fps playback).
